common_options.title: MCP server
common_options.guidance: Connecting a service through an MCP server is not available yet.

options.title: Sign in with your X developer app
options.guidance: Add an X account, then follow its Connect steps: you create an X app, paste its Client ID and sign in.

options.title: Sign in with Higgsfield
options.guidance: Image and video generation on your Higgsfield plan. You sign in once in the browser.

options.title: Higgsfield API key
options.guidance: Advanced: a developer API key with its own key ID, billed in dollars.

options.title: Gemini API key
options.guidance: Veo video and Gemini images. Create the key in Google AI Studio; billing must be on.

options.title: OpenAI API key
options.guidance: Image generation. A ChatGPT or Codex plan does not include API use.

options.title: LinkedIn Company Page posting
options.guidance: Information only: LinkedIn lets only approved apps post to a Company Page. You apply for its Community Management API; Clayrune cannot connect until that is granted.

options.title: YouTube channel
options.guidance: Information only: Clayrune has no YouTube connector yet.

options.title: Google Drive
options.guidance: Information only: Clayrune cannot read a Google Drive yet.

options.title: Google Photos
options.guidance: Information only: Clayrune cannot read Google Photos yet.
